title: 2U 服务器的 CPU 散热
summary: 两颗 270 W CPU 装在 2U 机箱里、进风 35 ℃、坏一只风扇也不能过 85 ℃：铜底 + 铝鳍片散热器、六只风扇；手算对流、鳍片效率、风道压降和风扇工作点，扫鳍片数选最少够用的；有限元算底板扩散热阻对照公式；老化曲线模型跑 12 小时；整机线做 20 台，老化后量 CPU 满载温度。
summary_en: Two 270 W CPUs in a 2U chassis, 35 °C inlet, must stay below 85 °C even with one fan failed: copper-base aluminium-fin heatsinks and six fans; convection, fin efficiency, duct pressure drop and fan operating point by hand, fin count swept for the fewest that work; FEA of base spreading vs formula; 12-hour burn-in on the curve model; 20 servers built and burned in.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 两颗 270 W CPU、进风 35 ℃、坏一只风扇仍 ≤ 85 ℃；散热器 108 × 100 × 68 mm。
steps.summary_en: Two 270 W CPUs, 35 °C inlet, ≤ 85 °C even with one fan failed; heatsink 108 × 100 × 68 mm.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 散热器热阻预算 ≤ 0.1531 K/W；选紫铜底板 + 铝鳍片（全铝 0.161，铜底 0.147 K/W）。
steps.summary_en: Heatsink budget ≤ 0.1531 K/W; copper base + aluminium fins chosen (all-aluminium 0.161, copper base 0.147 K/W).

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 44 片鳍片：散热器 0.1390 K/W；进风 35 ℃ 时 CPU 81.2 ℃，坏一只风扇 83.2 ℃。
steps.summary_en: 44 fins: heatsink 0.1390 K/W; CPU 81.2 °C at 35 °C inlet, 83.2 °C with one fan failed.

figs.caption: 鳍片数扫描、风扇—风道工作点
figs.caption_en: Fin-count sweep and fan operating point

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 有限元与公式：CPU 接触面温度相差 0.1 K；铝底板比铜热 3.7 ℃。老化曲线：进风 37 ℃ 满载最高 82.3 ℃。
steps.summary_en: FEA vs formula: 0.1 K at the CPU contact; aluminium base 3.7 °C hotter than copper. Burn-in model: 82.3 °C peak at 37 °C inlet.

figs.caption: 铜底板温度场、老化曲线、风扇转速
figs.caption_en: Copper base temperature, burn-in curves, fan speed

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 散热器：铜底 + 44 片铝鳍片、间距 2.50 mm；整机：风扇一排在前，两颗 CPU 并排、导风罩隔开。
steps.summary_en: Heatsink: copper base + 44 aluminium fins at 2.50 mm pitch; server: fans in one row, two CPUs side by side with ducting.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 整机线 6 道：每颗 CPU 点硅脂约 1.0 g、每班称重；散热器螺钉对角两遍；12 小时老化。
steps.summary_en: 6 operations: about 1.0 g paste per CPU, weighed every shift; heatsink screws diagonally in two passes; 12-hour burn-in.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 20 台：CPU 满载温度平均 73.1 ℃，不合格 0，最低 Cpk 1.34。
steps.summary_en: 20 servers: average full-load CPU temperature 73.1 °C; 0 failures, lowest Cpk 1.34.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 7 / 7 项校核通过；44 片鳍片、0.139 K/W、坏一只风扇 83.2 ℃。
steps.summary_en: 7 / 7 checks pass; 44 fins, 0.139 K/W, 83.2 °C with one fan failed.
